conventions.field: config fields are {value, basis[, note]}; basis in stated | inferred | not_stated.
conventions.measurement: {metric, value, unit, basis, spread[, note][, fraction_of_theoretical]}. spread null = none given; else {type: stdev | values_per_device, ...}.
conventions.fraction_of_theoretical: computed by the compiler (basis inferred) against theoretical_peaks[theoretical_id] when units match; entries above 1.0 get quality flag above_theoretical_peak.
conventions.family: gemm | gemv | tensor_core_microbenchmark | transformer_training | llm_inference | hashing | mining | vector_compute | molecular_dynamics
conventions.sparse: 2:4 sparse results count effective (dense-equivalent) FMA/FLOPs and are flagged; never compare them with dense peaks.
conventions.per_sm_units: FMA/clk/SM results are clock-independent: multiply by SM count x clock x 2 for FLOPS.
conventions.privacy: no usernames stored; forum/gist authors are identified only by the source URL.
